note: The transition registry: every transition / set-piece tin with the owner's verdict and the evidence. Read by tools/plan_check.py before any render. verdict: liked (praised, or kept in a standard after review), ok (shipped in an approved edit without comment), rejected (the owner disliked or removed it; don't reuse without the fix in 'fix'), banned (breaks a banned rule; never). tags: generic (filler; keep generic <= 30 %), black_occluder (bars / boxes / a dark surround: banned since v107), face_gimmick (graphics converging on a face: banned), signature (a custom graphic-into-transition; give it ~1 s), physical (a real object or phenomenon), lands_on_face (the incoming face must be centred at the landing). Add every new verdict here in the same turn as the handoff. Flash verdicts added by the Flash studio 2026-11-08 (studio 'flash': v10-v12 standards' transitions 'liked' per this definition, v13 rev 2 'ok', emblem_horizon 'rejected'). 'caution': a known technical trap, listed by tools/preflight.py. Where each transition is defined and used: studio/transitions_usage.json (generated by tools/preflight.py registry). Since the 2026-11-08 merge: the curated verdicts live here; the generated table (pre/post, engines, edits that used each transition) is studio/transitions_usage.json (`preflight.py registry`). Optional fields: `caution` (a technical trap, not a verdict), `set_piece` (handled by the edit's own code, no TR2 entry).
